description: Energías renovables - Radiación Solar Incidente is a dataset listed in Argentine national open data portal (datos.gob.ar), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría de Energía. Radiación solar incidente por unidad de área horizontal durante un periodo de tiempo determinado. ISO 19126: Natural Resources, Este subgrupo se compone de conceptos que se refieren a materias primas y sus depósitos. Coverage: Argentina. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría de Energía. Its tags are Energía solar, Energías renovables, Información geográfica, Radiación solar. It offers 24 resource(s) in CSV, SHP. The portal shows 2026-08-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ar-portal.
